Frequency once per hour

Range 60 feet

Duration 1 hour

The first time each hour that an ally sees and hears you recite the Litany, it gains a +1 status bonus to Will saves and to checks to resist fear for 1 hour. An ally that has never seen you recite before is also frightened 1 for one round as it takes in what you are actually doing — dread and awe arrive together, and neither is optional.
